from itertools import permutations

items = "FHLOPRST"
sols = []
for perm in permutations(items):
    pos = {c: i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(perm)}
    # T immediately before F or immediately after R
    if not (pos['T'] == pos['F'] - 1 or pos['T'] == pos['R'] + 1):
        continue
    # at least two compositions between F and R
    if abs(pos['F'] - pos['R']) - 1 < 2:
        continue
    # O is first or fifth
    if pos['O'] not in (1, 5):
        continue
    # eighth is L or H
    if perm[7] not in ('L', 'H'):
        continue
    # P before S
    if pos['P'] > pos['S']:
        continue
    # at least one composition between O and S
    if abs(pos['O'] - pos['S']) - 1 < 1:
        continue
    sols.append(perm)

print("total valid orders:", len(sols))
